newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA RTS TO INCREASE MAIN SHARE LISTINGS AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA RTS TO INCREASE MAIN SHARE LISTINGS AUG 11.

text.p: The Russian Trading System will increase the number of listed companies on its upper tier system by about one third effective August 11, the NAUFOR brokers association, which runs the RTS, said on Thursday.

The number of listed shares on the Russian Trading System will rise to 101 from 76. Shares will no longer be able to be listed on both the main and RTS-2 system for less liquid shares and so the number of RTS-2 listings will drop to 120 from 138.
Future decisions to transfer shares between levels will be taken only after three months of trade on one level.
The following companies will be transferred from RTS-2 to RTS-1 on Monday:
Bashkirskoye OAO Energetiki, ordinaries and prefs
AO Elektrosvyaz Rostovskoi oblasti, ordinaries and prefs
AO Elektrosvyaz Irkutskoi oblasti, ordinaries and prefs
OAO Elektrosvyaz Krasnoyarskogo Kraya, ordinaries and prefs
OAO Svyazinform Nizhny Novgorod, ordinaries and prefs
Rostov AO energetiki, ordinaries and prefs
AO Svyazinform Chelyabinsk, ordinaries and prefs
AO Svyazinform Samarskoi oblasti, ordinaries and prefs
The following shares will be transferred from RTS-1 to RTS-2: (all ordinaries)
OAO TRK Manezhnaya Ploshad AOOT Murmanskoe Morskoye Parokhodstvo (Murmansk Shipping)
